english.title: Not being an airline passenger fail to wear a pass reasonably visible in a restricted area at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not being a bona fide airline passenger, while in a restricted area at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Stansted Airport, failed to wear a pass issued to you by or on behalf of the Airport Company so that it was reasonably visible at all times
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(17) and 2(1) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
not being a bona fide airline passenger
in a restricted area at Stansted Airport
failed to wear a pass issued to him / her
by / on behalf of the Airport Company
so that it was reasonably visible at all times.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
